title: Flexible insulating sleeving, Part 1: Definitions and general requirements
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard ( Part 3/Sec 103 ) contains requirements for non-heat shrinkable sleeving of circular cross section, extruded from PVC { polyvinyl chloride ) for the general purpose grade sleeving with temperature index 90 with Type 2 sleeving employing unilateral tolerances on bore diameter.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Flexible insulating sleeving, Part 2: Methods of tests

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
